title: aⁿbⁿ: push an a, pop one for each b
notes: The machine pushes $ to mark the bottom, pushes an a for every a, and pops an a for every b. When $ is back on top, every a has been matched, and an ε-move pops it on the way to the accept state q3. On aab one a is still on the stack when the input runs out.
ops: start q0; accept q0 q3; q0 eps, eps -> q1 $; q1 a, eps -> q1 a; q1 b, a -> q2 eps; q2 b, a -> q2 eps; q2 eps, $ -> q3 eps
